videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of the provided YouTube video subtitles in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the text:
1. Central Election Management Commission (선관위) made errors in entering vote counting results for the education superintendent election - entered results from one polling station into another station's data, causing votes from 1,104 voters to effectively disappear/be duplicated.
2. In Jeonju Wansan-gu, results from Jungwhasan 3rd polling station were entered into 1st polling station's data, causing 104 votes from 1st station to be omitted while 3rd station results were counted twice.
3. Separately, regarding ballot paper shortage: While they claimed they printed too few ballots, the bigger issue was distribution failure. In Jamsil 3rd and 4th districts, they were supposed to print 60% (higher than the standard 50%) due to low early voting rates, but Jamsil 4th district 7th polling station only received 1,400 ballots instead of the required 1,921 (60% of eligible voters), causing shortages and voting suspensions, while other districts had over 42,000 leftover ballots.
4. The election commission established a fact-finding committee with only 10 days and no compulsory investigation powers.
